fields.sourceEnglish: Worm-bin leachate is not automatically safe fertiliser; keep it off edible plants
fields.currentDraft: Worm-bin leachate is not automatically safe fertiliser; keep it off edible plants
fields.sesothoDraft: Leachate ya worm bin ha ya lokela ho nkwa e le fertiliser e bolokehileng ka bohona; do not use it on edible plants.
fields.literalBacktranslation: Worm-bin leachate should not automatically be considered a safe fertiliser; do not use it on edible plants.
fields.uncertainty: Retains “not automatically safe” rather than claiming the liquid is always unsafe; keeps leachate, worm bin, fertiliser and edible plants explicit. Independent review should check that “keep it off” reads as a clear use prohibition.

fields.sourceEnglish: Wind erosion of dry topsoil and loss of soil structure from spring storm impact
fields.currentDraft: Wind erosion of dry topsoil and loss of soil structure from spring storm impact
fields.sesothoDraft: Wind erosion ya topsoil e ommeng le tahlehelo ya soil structure ka lebaka la tshusumetso ya spring storm.
fields.literalBacktranslation: Wind erosion of dry topsoil and loss of soil structure because of spring storm impact.
fields.uncertainty: Keeps technical wind erosion, topsoil, soil structure and spring storm terms explicit. This remains the correct option at index 2; do not change order or correct index.

fields.sourceEnglish: Bare soil is exposed to winter wind, which can carry away dry topsoil. Raindrop impact can damage the surface; where water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
fields.currentDraft: Bare soil is exposed to winter wind, which can carry away dry topsoil. Raindrop impact can damage the surface; where water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
fields.sesothoDraft: Mobu o sa kwahelwang o pepesetswa moya wa mariha, o ka nkang topsoil e ommeng wa tsamaya nayo. Tshusumetso ya marothodi a pula e ka senya bokahodimo; moo metsi a phallang hodima tshimo, a ka nka mobu o hlephileng a o tlosa.
fields.literalBacktranslation: Uncovered soil is exposed to winter wind, which can carry dry topsoil away. Raindrop impact can damage the surface; where water flows over the field, it can carry loose soil away.
fields.uncertainty: Preserves both “can” statements and the conditional “where water runs over the field”; does not generalize runoff to the whole field.

fields.sourceEnglish: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it must not be presented as a guaranteed safe feed for edible crops.
fields.currentDraft: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it must not be presented as a guaranteed safe feed for edible crops.
fields.sesothoDraft: Leachate ke liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Composition ya yona e a fapana, kahoo ha ya lokela ho hlahiswa jwalo ka feed e bolokehileng ka tiisetso bakeng sa edible crops.
fields.literalBacktranslation: Leachate is liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin. Its composition varies, so it should not be presented as feed guaranteed safe for edible crops.
fields.uncertainty: Retains natural drainage, variable composition and prohibition on presenting it as guaranteed-safe feed for edible crops. Keeps leachate/feed/edible crops technical terms in English.
